primary_source: Alain Connes, Trace formula in noncommutative geometry and the zeros of the Riemann zeta function, arXiv:math/9811068
verified_from_source: O_S^* is defined as the S-unit subgroup and is cocompact in the norm-one S-ideles.
A multiplicative fundamental domain D for the O_S^* action on J_S is explicitly used to normalize Haar measure.
L2(X_S) is defined by completing and separating the Schwartz space under a norm computed on C_S or a fundamental domain D.
A trace formula is proved in the S-local case for cutoff operators R_Lambda U(h).
The quotient trace kernel is expressed as a sum over q in O_S^* integrated over D.
not_verified_by_source: Li's exact operator T_h is identical to Connes's R_Lambda U(h).
Li's compressed operators in T3/T4 satisfy Connes's theorem without new hypotheses.
Li's E_S^{-1}, P_Lambda, S_Lambda, and transpose notation exactly match the source conventions.
The finite-Lambda asymptotic trace formula directly implies Li's exact zero/nonnegative trace components.
